أستحم (form X)

# أَسْتَحِمَّ (ʔastaḥimma) /ʔas.ta.ħim.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَمَّ (istaḥamma)
# أَسْتَحِمِّ (ʔastaḥimmi) /ʔas.ta.ħim.mi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحَمَّ (istaḥamma)
